1.he: וְיִסַּר הַזְּמַן בִּכְלַל הֲמוֹנָיו לְחַנְפֵי לֵב, וְלִי – בִּכְלָל וּבִפְרָט
1.note: The construction of "chastened" with the preposition is unusual. Sense taken: the false of heart get the blows of Time only as part of the crowd; the speaker gets them as part of the crowd and also individually. "General and particular" are terms of rabbinic interpretation.

2.note: A quotation of Hos 4:10 in the first person plural. Its speaker is not clear; it is taken here as an aside of the debtor.

3.note: "Fourth generation" (as Exod 20:5) is one possibility; "four times as rich" is another.

4.note: "Bowl" is the capital of a pillar (1 Kgs 7:41). The point of the image is not certain; a play on golah, "exile", is possible.

5.note: The verse (Isa 16:4) is quoted against its sense. Probably: now your power to comfort is spent.

6.note: A formula of the laws of sacrifice. The point of the insult is not certain.

7.note: Three rhyming words of praise. "Daughter of Aaron" and "moon-like" are probable; the third word is not certain.

8.he: כִּי לֹא כְבַת נַעֲוָה ... אִשְׁתִּי רְאוּיָה אֶל גְּבִיר בֶּן עַוְלָה
8.note: The syntax of these two lines is hard. Sense taken: my wife is not a woman who deserves a wicked husband, therefore I made myself wise.

9.note: Literally "to him it is fitting, more than watchmen for the morning". The subject (the wife, or the marriage) is supplied.
